reason: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer. The sachet is a nice idea for my bag, but I would not pay this much to find out.
objection: It costs more than what I already know, and I am not sure the sachet is worth the extra money when I forget vitamins anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $19 to $20 a box, or a cheap trial box so I can see if I actually remember to take it.
